description: This file defines the TerminationSignalWatcher class, which manages handling UNIX termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) in an application. It installs signal handlers, logs when signals are received, stops pairing prompts, and terminates the application gracefully.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: A singleton class that monitors termination signals and initiates application shutdown procedures.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for termination signals SIGTERM and SIGINT, installing handlers if not already installed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for signals, cancels handlers, and resets state.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a signal handler for the specified signal number.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the received signal by stopping pairing prompts, terminating the app, and scheduling a forced exit after 3 seconds.
